Margherita College played an important role in my growth. Along with academics, being part of the Gender Champion Committee, NSS, and various debate and quiz competitions helped me learn and gain confidence. The teachers here provide you with adequate support to flourish. I am a proud alumnus of the college.
Jagriti Sarmah (Alumnus, Dept. of History)
हमारा कॉलेज उत्तम शिक्षण व्यवस्था से परिपूर्ण है, यहां अनुशासन को महत्व दिया जाता है तथा छात्र-छात्राओं के संपूर्ण विकास के लिए एक अनुकूल और उत्कृष्ट वातावरण मिलता है। छात्र-छात्राओं के विकास हेतु विभिन्न प्रकार की सुविधा मिलती है जैसे पुस्तकालय, कंप्यूटर लैब, लैंग्वेज लैब आदि कॉलेज में पढ़ाई के साथ-साथ सांस्कृतिक और खेल गतिविधियों को भी महत्व दिया जाता है जो हमारे मानसिक व शारीरिक विकास में योगदान देती है।
Anjali Ghose
FYUGP B.A. Semeter IV (Hindi Major)
Over the years, I've grown both academically and personally at Margherita College. At each stage, the college's nurturing environment and the unwavering support from my teachers played a pivotal role in building my confidence and strengthening my passion for my studies. Just as experiential learning transforms knowledge into real-life growth, this journey has been my own enlightening odyssey.
Sneha Das
FYUGP B.A. 5th Semester (Political Science Major)
Getting admission to Margherita College was a leap into the unknown, but looking back, it was one of the best decisions I've ever made. The teachers are incredibly helpful and open-minded, always ready to support every student. The campus environment is peaceful and welcoming, creating a perfect atmosphere for both learning and personal growth.
Sarbananda Maut
FYUGP B.Com 5th Semester (Finance Major)
Margherita College shaped more than just my intellect. It gave me purpose, confidence, and space to flourish. It's the place where I uncovered my true self. Each event, every challenge, and every stage experience strengthened me, sharpened my wisdom, and fueled my passion.
Bristi Dey
FYUGP 5th Sem (English Major)
